visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with short spiky hair and glasses wearing a brown t-shirt holds a large bundle of yellow dry spaghetti. He waves it towards the camera lens in a kitchen setting with white wall tiles and a window. A colorful illustration of a finished salmon pesto pasta dish briefly overlays the frame. (2) The man stands in the kitchen. He places the long spaghetti sticks into a bubbling transparent glass pot on a gas stove. He holds black chopsticks and carefully presses the ends of the spaghetti to submerge them into the boiling water without breaking them. (3) A close-up shot focuses on the glass pot on the stove. The water is boiling vigorously as the spaghetti softens. The black chopsticks stir the noodles in a circular motion to prevent sticking. (4) In a black non-stick frying pan, a salmon fillet with skin on is being seared. A hand enters the frame holding a white plastic packet and squeezes a thick, vibrant green pesto sauce over the cooking fish. (5) The cooked yellow spaghetti is added to the frying pan with the salmon and green sauce. A black spatula is used to toss and mix the ingredients together until the noodles are well-coated with the green pesto. (6) A close-up shot of the man's face as he uses a fork to eat a large mouthful of the green pasta. He slurps the noodles, chews with a satisfied expression, and looks upwards thoughtfully.
